messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: inference-gateway-prod error rate spike >20% (5m) — multiple PD incidents firing: PDINC-8921. Link: https://alerts.redwood.example/inference-gateway-prod
Alex S: seeing it, oncall woke. looks like US-WEST nodes, bursty 500s. paging PD and triage.
Maria G: thanks. is it gateway or model runtime? any recent deploys?
Alex S: no deploys in last 3h. initial traces look like backend auth errors (403s) and some downstream KV timeouts.
Ben T: I can tail proxy logs. pushing a quick query to the dashboard: `errors.rate{service:inference-gateway,env:prod}.rollup(5m)` -> 23%
Priya R: this is spamming PagerDuty — multiple pages in <2m. can we do a temporary quiet window so oncall isn't paged every burst?
Alex S: yes. plan: create a PD temporary suppress + add slack-only squelch for the noisy alert group. keep pages for critical (customer-facing 5xx >60%).
Maria G: good. how do we identify group key? currently alerts include cluster+route. bursts look per-cluster. propose group_by: `service,cluster,alert_type` and dedupe threshold = 4/min.
Ben T: I have a quick tweak for the deduper service. adding a new profile: `burst-damp-30m` with rate_limit=1/5m per group and backoff window=15m. should cut storm pages.
Alex S: can someone run the temporary command? I don't have pd access from phone.
Priya R: on it. running: `/pdctl silence add --service inference-gateway-prod --duration 30m --reason "noisy auth/timeouts; applying temporary dedupe"`
Ops Bot: /pdctl result: silence created (id: SLC-3345) — expires in 30m.
Maria G: also enabling slack squelch channel-only for the raw error alert so we still see counts in dashboard but not every firing.
Ben T: pushing deduper config patch now. snippet:
```yaml
# alertrouter/deduper/profiles.yaml
profiles:
  - name: burst-damp-30m
    group_by: ["service","cluster","alert_type"]
    rate_limit: "1/300" # 1 per 5m
    backoff_minutes: 15
    max_repeat: 6
```
Ben T: applying as a live config to staging then to prod via `opsctl config apply alertrouter/deduper --env prod --profile burst-damp-30m`
Alex S: :thumbsup: keep slack channel visible for volume metrics. we need to confirm customer-impact. which customers hit errors?
Priya R: quick query: `topk(5, sum by(customer_id)(errors{service=\"inference-gateway\"}))` -> customers A12, B34, internal-test. A12 showing ~45% of errors but still degraded requests ~3% of their traffic.
Maria G: reaching out to A12 CSM and infra contact. @oncall-sre please prepare a short status note if they ask.
Ben T: prod config rolled out. `opsctl` returned ok. deduper reports initial suppression logs: 87 alerts suppressed in last 5m (most from cluster-west-2).
Alex S: great. leaving the PD silence in place for 30m and monitoring. next steps: create ticket to adjust alert threshold permanently and add dashboard panels for suppressed_count and suppression_ratio.
Priya R: creating ticket now: TKT-5142 — "Add burst-damp dedupe profile + dashboard + PD routing rule" link: https://tracker.redwood.example/TKT-5142
Maria G: also we should add a canary rule: if suppressed_count > 100 and error_rate > 10% then escalate to PD regardless of suppression. avoids hiding real incidents.
Alex S: agree. add to TKT-5142.
Ben T: small log snippet from proxy showing pattern: ```
[2026-03-15T10:11:02Z] ERROR route=/v1/complete status=502 downstream=kv timeout=1500ms
[2026-03-15T10:11:03Z] ERROR route=/v1/complete status=403 auth=token-expired user=svc-abc
[2026-03-15T10:11:05Z] ERROR route=/v1/complete status=502 downstream=kv timeout=1600ms
```
Priya R: fyi I've pinged A12 and CSM. they'll hold until we confirm root cause.
Alex S: rough timeline: mitigation in place (silence + dedupe) at 10:14, next check at 10:30. if stable, we'll drop silence and keep dedupe profile for gradual rollout.
Maria G: ETA for dashboard panels? Ben?
Ben T: can add minimal panels in 20m: suppressed_count, suppression_rate, grouped_errors_by_cluster. will post dashboards link when done.
Ops Bot: Deploybot: config apply to alertrouter succeeded (deploy id: DB-9901).
Priya R: handing off monitoring to Maria for the next 30m while I follow up with A12. Alex, if you need me back, ping me.
Alex S: handing to Maria. Maria, you're the responder for the handoff. I'll be reachable.
Maria G: taking over. will watch the dashboards and PD for any uncaught escalations. will update the thread at 10:30 with status. :eyes:
Priya R: added note to TKT-5142 with initial suppression metrics and customer impact summary.
Alex S: thanks all. one action item list in thread so we don't lose it:
- Priya: follow up with A12 + update ticket (TKT-5142)
- Ben: add dashboard panels + verify suppression canary rule
- Maria: monitor and update in 20m
- Alex: decide on permanent threshold change after root cause

Maria G: 10:30 update: error rate trending down to 4% aggregate. suppressed alerts dropped to near zero as bursts subsided. PD silence expires in 10m. leaving deduper profile active for next 24h to collect data.
Alex S: perfect. closeable once ticket gets PR for alert change and dashboard merged.
Priya R: I'll keep the PD silence until it expires; will not extend unless customer impact increases.
Ben T: opening PR for dashboard + deduper docs: https://git.redwood.example/pulls/2218
Maria G: thanks team, nice quick coordination. :sparkles:
Alex S: closing handoff. if anything spikes, reopen this thread.
Maria G: noted. thread locked to keep quiet, will reopen as needed.
